 Follow US urges citizens to be extra cautious in Europe during holidays
 DPA Mon, November 16, 2026 at 10:48 PM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. FILE PHOTO - A view of the US State Department. (is associated with: «US urges citizens to be extra cautious in Europe during holidays») Michael Kappeler/dpa The United States is calling on its citizens to be extra vigilant when visiting Europe during the Christmas season, according to security alerts published on Monday by US embassies and diplomatic missions in several European countries.
 The alerts urge people to remain vigilant, particularly at large gatherings and public events, warning that such locations could be potential targets for terrorist groups and criminals.
 However, the alerts do not cite any specific information about a planned attack or a particular threat. Potential targets listed include markets, shopping centres and transport hubs.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The embassies also warn of possible travel disruptions caused by strikes and demonstrations, as well as a recent series of hoax bomb threats affecting European air travel.
 The warnings were issued in countries including Germany, Spain, Britain and Portugal.
